tweets.text:
If I knew that the @FBI places people on their terror watchlist over first amendment protected speech I would never have commented on the posts of any Democrat politician and I wouldn’t have made some posts. 

The thought of having my life wrecked because of a few miscalculated words is very desolating. 

I never would have guessed that the US government misuses the terror watchlist to essentially criminally convict people over 1st amendment speech and I underestimated how hysterical leftists are. 

I once made a post expressing intent of meeting in person with a Democrat senator to have a civil conversation but of course a woman misinterpreted my comment as a threat and made an FBI report on me stating that I threatened the senator. At first I didn’t think much of it but when I learned that you can be included on the TSDB over anything I felt devastated. 

I tried contacting @DHSgov , @TheJusticeDept and the FBI itself for a clarification but they never answered. 

This has gotten me very worried. This is why I started making posts questioning the constitutionality of the FBI, CIA, DHS, NSA and how they attack free speech. 

I was avoiding commenting about this matter out of fear but if they are gonna surveil you over any small thing there is no point in hiding.
